name: Eval Dashboard renders its own empty state, not a route fallback
description: Loads the app root, then clicks the sidebar's Eval Dashboard nav item and confirms /evals renders its OWN empty-agents copy — not merely that the URL changed. A build where the route wired up but rendered a generic fallback (or nothing) even though navigation succeeded would pass a URL-only check; the final text assertion is copy that exists only on this dashboard (client/src/app/evals/page.tsx via dashboard.emptyAgents), so it fails on that build. No control that starts a run is clicked — the hermetic seed has no eval cases and this flow must not trigger a model call.

steps.label: click the sidebar's Eval Dashboard nav item

cmd: No agent has an eval set yet.
steps.label: the dashboard's own empty-agents copy renders — no other route has this text
